purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche K certification benchmark authored only after r21 was merged, deployed, and the current-live-publication verification succeeded. It was not used to construct r21 and stresses generalization across adjacent shared procedures, direct-permission semantics, card interactions, source fit, follow-up context, polarity, unsupported gaps, and out-of-scope restraint.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored only after production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded for v071-qa-20260918-21; it was not used to construct r21.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade tranche K after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-K case may become regression coverage only after diagnosis and may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche K, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J questions.
Question-scoped semantic criteria require only what the question asks.
expectedSourceGroups are OR-lists within a governing requirement; separate groups remain independently required.

cases.question: A card has both an Action effect and an Asset effect. If I play it from Hand for its Action effect, does its Asset text also apply just because it is printed on the same card?
expectedSourceGroups: Only the printed effect being used applies

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Using one printed effect does not also apply the card's other printed effects unless a rule says otherwise.

cases.question: A card effect directly tells me to bank another card immediately. Do I also spend a separate Action for that banking unless the instruction says so?
expectedSourceGroups: does not spend or require another Action unless the instruction expressly says

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A directly instructed banking procedure is part of resolving the effect and does not consume another Action unless the instruction expressly requires one.

cases.question: An effect grants me movement after my normal Movement sequence has already ended. Does that granted movement begin a new movement sequence?
expectedSourceGroups: If the effect grants movement while no movement sequence is in progress, it begins a new movement sequence

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Effect-granted movement starts a new movement sequence when no movement sequence is already in progress.

cases.question: A card gives me an additional Tactic after Tactics have already been revealed. Is that added Tactic played face down and does it reopen the reveal window?
expectedSourceGroups: after Tactics are revealed, play it face up
does not reopen an earlier choice, reveal, or response window

semanticCriteria.statement: No. An additional Tactic added after reveal is played face up, and choosing it does not reopen an earlier choice, reveal, or response window.

cases.question: My Tactic is negated but no effect gives it a different destination. Does it still go to my Discard Pile in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: a negated Tactic still goes to its owner's Discard Pile during the Aftermath

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Negation removes the effect, not the normal Tactic destination; it still goes to its owner's Discard Pile unless another effect says otherwise.

cases.question: An effect says it happens at the end of the Aftermath. Does that timing come before or after battle cards clear and their zone-entry triggers resolve?
expectedSourceGroups: Effects at the end of the Aftermath occur after the battle cards are cleared and effects triggered by those moves are applied

semanticCriteria.statement: After. End-of-Aftermath effects occur after battle cards clear and after effects triggered by those card movements are applied.

cases.question: A card is bound face down beneath another card. May the opponent inspect that bound card just because it is on the table?
expectedSourceGroups: A face-down bound card may be inspected only by its owner

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A face-down bound card may be inspected only by its owner.

cases.question: A printed effect reads 'Defender — gain Advantage. +1 Battle Total.' Does the Defender condition automatically apply to the later +1 Battle Total clause too?
expectedSourceGroups: A condition prefix applies only to the clause that immediately follows it

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A condition prefix applies only to the clause immediately following it unless the text separately conditions the later clause.

cases.question: An effect tells me to repeat another effect that normally requires a cost and a choice. On the repeated application, do I reuse the old choice and avoid paying again?
expectedSourceGroups: Make all choices again and pay all costs again for each new application

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Each repeated application makes its choices again and pays its costs again.

cases.question: I apply the effect of a card in my Graveyard without actually playing that card. Does applying its effect move the source card out of the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: does not play, set, choose, or otherwise move the source card
The source card remains in its current zone

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Applying another card's effect does not move the source card unless the instruction expressly says so; it remains in its current zone.

cases.question: I legally capture the Territory at my opponent's end, and another voluntary procedure would normally be available later in the phase. Do I wait to resolve that later procedure before winning?
expectedSourceGroups: immediately runs the Gauntlet and wins the game
before proceeding to a later phase or voluntary procedure

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Capturing the opponent's final Territory wins immediately after the capture and its required immediate consequences, before later voluntary procedures.

cases.question: I control a Territory and my opponent is occupying it. If I initiate a battle against them there, is that battle a Counterattack?
expectedSourceGroups: battle initiated by the controller of a Territory against an opponent who is the occupier of that Territory

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. That is the definition of a Counterattack.

cases.question: My Terms are accepted and the Proposal itself gives no special movement. By default, who withdraws and who remains at the contested Position?
expectedSourceGroups: Unless the Proposal says otherwise, the attacker withdraws and the defender remains at the contested Position

semanticCriteria.statement: By default, the attacker withdraws and the defender remains at the contested Position.

cases.question: After my Terms are refused, I have 2 Influence tied up as the Stake and no free Influence. Can I spend that Stake for Leverage before dice?
expectedSourceGroups: Staked Influence cannot be spent as Leverage

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Influence committed as the Stake cannot be spent for Leverage.

cases.question: Financial Capacity was active after Capture. Later in the same turn my Treasury value drops below the number of Territories I control. Do I lose the two-Action permission for that turn?
expectedSourceGroups: Determine eligibility once at this timing; later Treasury or control changes do not grant or remove the permission that turn

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Financial Capacity eligibility is determined once after Capture; later Treasury or control changes do not remove the permission that turn.

cases.question: My Income gain would put my Capital above my current Capital limit. Is the excess immediately lost?
expectedSourceGroups: Income may temporarily exceed the Capital limit

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Income may temporarily raise Capital above the Capital limit.

cases.question: My Active Mission's requirement becomes satisfied during a battle. Does the Mission complete automatically at that moment?
expectedSourceGroups: Satisfying the requirement does not complete it automatically

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A satisfied Active Mission still requires its Denouement completion Action.

cases.question: When a Special Operation is completed, does it also give the normal Mission reward of 1 Operation Progress plus Intel equal to the card's value?
expectedSourceGroups: A Special Operation uses the printed Mission requirement but is not a normal Mission. It grants no Mission reward

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A Special Operation is not a normal Mission and grants no normal Mission reward.

cases.question: I pay to abort my Active Mission during Denouement. Does that count as the Mission failing and send it to the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: Put it in the Discard Pile. Aborting is not failure

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Aborting is not failure; the aborted Mission goes to the Discard Pile after the abort cost is paid.

cases.question: I copy the effect of an Arcane card without playing, setting, or choosing that Arcane card again. Does the copied application trigger Invocation?
expectedSourceGroups: A copied effect does not trigger Invocation unless the Arcane card is itself played, set, or chosen again

semanticCriteria.statement: No. A copied effect alone does not trigger Invocation unless the Arcane card itself is played, set, or chosen again and its printed effect is applied.

cases.question: I put a card from Hand into my Graveyard for Transmutation. Do any of that card's printed effects resolve because I used its value?
expectedSourceGroups: The card is not played and none of its printed effects apply

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The Transmutation card is not played and none of its printed effects apply.

cases.question: Rite of Blood is active. I win a later battle without setting a Gambit or choosing a Tactic, but I did use Transmutation. Can Rite of Blood still complete?
expectedSourceGroups: does not by itself prevent completion

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Using Transmutation does not by itself prevent Rite of Blood from completing when the battle is won without setting a Gambit or choosing a Tactic.

cases.question: Condemnation applies in the Aftermath. Do the opponent's cards that remained in Reserve also go to the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: Cards remaining in the opponent's Reserve are discarded normally

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Condemnation changes opposing Tactic destinations; cards remaining in Reserve are discarded normally.

cases.question: No Martyrs applies after the opponent loses. Does it prevent the opponent's required retreat itself?
expectedSourceGroups: It does not prevent harmful consequences, the retreat itself

semanticCriteria.statement: No. No Martyrs prevents the losing opponent from benefiting from their own loss/retreat triggers, but it does not prevent the retreat itself.

cases.question: Conscription resolves its Action and then lets me immediately play a card from Hand whose Action effect banks it. Does that immediate bank require me to spend another Action?
expectedSourceGroups: You may immediately play one card from your Hand whose Action effect banks it
does not spend or require another Action unless the instruction expressly says

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Conscription directly permits the immediate play/bank as part of its resolution, so it does not require another Action unless the instruction says otherwise.

cases.question: I use Black Covenant as my Tactic and take its +1 Tactic from Hand. Where do Black Covenant and that added Tactic go in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: In the Aftermath, put this card and that card in your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Both Black Covenant and the Tactic it added from Hand go to your Graveyard in the Aftermath.

cases.question: I reveal Trade Concessions while offering Terms and the opponent refuses. Does Trade Concessions stay set aside until the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: Refused — Return this card to your Hand before Gambits are set

semanticCriteria.statement: No. On refusal, Trade Concessions returns to your Hand before Gambits are set.

cases.question: Plenipotentiary ratifies an unratified Proposal immediately after the opponent refuses it. Do I gain the normal Influence for that ratification, and does the Proposal's Refused effect still happen?
expectedSourceGroups: Gain no Influence for ratifying it this way. Its Refused effect still applies

semanticCriteria.statement: You gain no Influence for the Plenipotentiary ratification, and the Proposal's Refused effect still applies.

cases.question: War Bonds is banked. After the first battle of the turn, I put a card from Hand into my Treasury. What resource gain comes with that placement?
expectedSourceGroups: After the first battle each turn, you may place one card from your Hand face up in your Treasury. If you do, +1 Capital

semanticCriteria.statement: You gain 1 Capital when War Bonds places the Hand card face up in your Treasury after the first battle that turn.

cases.question: I lose a battle on a Tiebreak Roll while Actuarial Alchemy is banked. Can its Capital gain use the amount by which the opponent's Tiebreak Roll beat mine?
expectedSourceGroups: gain Capital equal to the amount by which your opponent's Battle Total or Tiebreak Roll exceeded yours

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Actuarial Alchemy expressly permits the Capital gain to use the Tiebreak Roll margin.

cases.question: I use Scouting Report as a battle card and choose to replace it with an eligible card from my Reserve. Is the replacement face down, and where does Scouting Report go?
expectedSourceGroups: replace this card with an eligible card from your Reserve, face up. If you replace it, put this card in your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: The replacement is face up, and Scouting Report goes to your Graveyard.

cases.question: I control Stand Ground and lose a battle. Can I discard Stand Ground to ignore the normal retreat caused by losing?
expectedSourceGroups: When an opposing card effect would move you
A player retreats because they lost a battle

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Stand Ground responds to movement caused by an opposing card effect; the normal retreat is caused by the battle result, not an opposing card effect.

cases.question: I lose and make my normal retreat. The opponent's Court Martial then adds Retreat +1. Can Stand Ground ignore that extra card-effect movement without undoing my normal retreat?
expectedSourceGroups: When an opposing card effect would move you, you may discard this card to ignore that movement

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Stand Ground can ignore Court Martial's additional card-effect movement, while the normal retreat already caused by the loss remains.

cases.question: Ranger begins Movement on Quicksand and has not used Fieldcraft this turn. Can Ranger spend 1 Intel to ignore Quicksand's printed movement restriction for the turn?
expectedSourceGroups: When a printed Territory effect would affect you, your movement, or a battle involving you, ignore that effect until the end of the turn
cannot Advance or Fall Back more than one Position or use an effect to increase their movement that turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Fieldcraft may ignore Quicksand's printed Territory effect because it affects Ranger's movement.

cases.question: Countercharge advances me one Position at the end of the Aftermath after I win while defending. If that Position enters the opponent's Position, may it initiate a new battle?
expectedSourceGroups: Effect-granted movement may initiate a battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Countercharge grants movement, and effect-granted movement may initiate a battle unless expressly prohibited.

cases.question: The opponent accepts my Trade Concessions and chooses 'Bank one eligible card from Hand.' Does banking that chosen card consume my normal Action for the turn?
expectedSourceGroups: Bank one eligible card from Hand
does not spend or require another Action unless the instruction expressly says

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Trade Concessions directly instructs the banking as part of the Accepted effect, so it does not consume the player's normal Action.

cases.question: So that second card doesn't use another Action?

history.content: I played Conscription for its Action, drew the card, and I'm using its instruction to immediately play a card whose Action effect banks it.
Conscription directly permits that immediate play during its own resolution.

expectedSourceGroups: immediately play one card from your Hand whose Action effect banks it
does not spend or require another Action unless the instruction expressly says

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. The immediately played banking card does not consume another Action; it is directly permitted by Conscription's resolving effect.

cases.question: And that doesn't give me another Operation Progress when I finish it?

history.content: My Special Operation is ready and I can pay its completion cost in Denouement.
If its requirement remains satisfied, you can complete it and win by paying the Special Operation cost.

expectedSourceGroups: not a normal Mission. It grants no Mission reward

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. Completing a Special Operation does not award the normal Mission reward, including Operation Progress.

cases.question: So it's back in my Hand before I choose a Gambit?

history.content: I revealed Trade Concessions with my Terms and the opponent refused.
Trade Concessions follows its Refused clause.

expectedSourceGroups: Return this card to your Hand before Gambits are set

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Trade Concessions returns to your Hand before Gambits are set.

cases.question: But my original retreat still happened, right?

history.content: I lost, retreated normally, then Court Martial tried to make me retreat one more Position. I discarded Stand Ground against that extra movement.
Stand Ground can address movement caused by the opposing card effect.

expectedSourceGroups: When an opposing card effect would move you
A player retreats because they lost a battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Stand Ground can stop the extra Court Martial movement, but it does not undo the normal retreat already caused by losing the battle.

cases.question: We accidentally drew four Reserve cards instead of three and saw all four before noticing. Does published v0.7.1 define an official repair procedure for that mistake?

semanticCriteria.statement: Published v0.7.1 does not define a general official repair procedure for accidentally drawing and seeing an extra Reserve card; the Arbiter should identify the gap and may issue a clearly provisional table ruling.

cases.question: Is Black Covenant too strong and should its cost be increased in the next release?

semanticCriteria.statement: This asks for game-design and balance judgment rather than a v0.7.1 gameplay-rules ruling, so the Rules Arbiter should give a concise scope boundary rather than recommend a balance change.

cases.question: Write new flavor text for War Bonds.

semanticCriteria.statement: This is creative writing rather than a gameplay-rules ruling, so the Rules Arbiter should give a concise scope boundary instead of writing flavor text.
